title: Every Warden-only 'state your business plainly / let your bearing speak' option that touches a Free Company NPC (the hunter's wolf offer, Captain Vane, Harbourmaster Rennick) costs Free Companies standing because it 'reads as Watch.' This is a consistent, real mechanical downside of the Warden class that is never mentioned at character creation, where the Warden is pitched purely on strengths ('steel opens what words and lore cannot').
where: character select (Warden) vs. later '(as a Warden)' dialogue options
